Indian Navy Receives Second Indigenous Diving Support Vessel

The Indian Navy accepted delivery of the Nipun, its second Diving Support Vessel (DSV), on July 30. Built by Hindustan Shipyard Limited (HSL), the Nipun is designed for deep-sea diving and submarine rescue operations. This induction is part of the 'Aatmanirbhar Bharat' initiative, promoting self-reliance in defense manufacturing.
